Tango Tabi

Tango Tabi

Founder & Developer

About the Project

Tango Tabi (単語旅, "word journey") is a suite of gamified apps to learn Japanese vocabulary at your own pace and put it to the test in fun challenges with friends. It's my own project, built end to end: product, design, frontend, backend and deployment.

Two apps, one journey. In Tango Dojo you learn and consolidate words through short daily sessions: kana, daily vocabulary and reinforcement of the words you struggle with most. In Tango Duels you travel across Japan defeating rivals in word battles. Both apps share your account, name and character, and your progress is saved across all your devices.

Teaser music: «Pasajeros», by fiftysounds.com.

What I Built

As founder and sole developer, I own every part of the product, from game design to infrastructure.

Product & Game Design

Designed the learning loop and gamification of both apps: practice modes, streaks, progress tracking and a shared character across the ecosystem.

Spaced Repetition App

Built Tango Dojo as an installable web app (PWA) with React, TypeScript, Zustand and Tailwind, playable in the browser and on mobile without installing anything.

Shared Architecture

Extracted a shared package with types, the word catalog and the backend client, so both apps speak the same contract and share one account system.

Backend & Deployment

Supabase backend for accounts and cross-device progress, with deployments to Cloudflare through GitHub Actions.
